name: Exchange of the Spirit
card_text: If both players have 15 or more cards in their GYs: Pay 1000 LP; each player swaps the cards in their GY with the cards in their Deck, then shuffles their Deck. You can only activate 1 "Exchange of the Spirit" per Duel.
available_set: PREMIUM GOLD: RETURN OF THE BLING
DUELIST PACK - RIVALS OF THE PHARAOH -
